lines.text: {task}. One clean cut. Begin with the first stroke and let the rest wait.
The road to {task} begins with a single step. Take it now, unhurried.
Begin {task} as you would dawn practice: no hurry, no audience, full attention.
{task} has waited a long time. A patient blade is not a dull one. Begin.
Written today, begun today. {task} will have no time to grow heavy.
{task} is complete. Sheathe the blade, breathe, then choose: the next task, or rest.
{task} is done, and patience is visible in its edges. Take the next stage of the road when you are ready.
It is finished: {task}. You returned to it, and that is what I noticed. Rest a while, or begin the next.
{task} sat on the road for weeks, and today you walked it. Rest before the next stage.
{task}, complete. One cut, cleanly made. Step away and let the ink dry.
A new day on the road. {task} is the first step; take it calmly.
Dawn practice begins with one form. Today, that form is {task}.
A new day. One task, done with care, is a worthy beginning.
{task} is done. Day after day, you return to the work. That is how a path is worn into a hillside.
The days are adding up. Steady practice outlasts any single brilliant stroke.
Ten days and more of returning to the work. My teacher would have nodded once, and that nod was rare.
Welcome back to the road. Today is a fresh stage, and {task} is today's step.
You have returned, and the road is still here. One step is all today asks.
Welcome back. The journey continues today, with {task}.
Enough planning. A blade is not sharpened by looking at it. Close the app and begin.
The road is out there, not on this screen. Close the app and take the next step.
Rest is also practice. If the work is done, close the app and rest.
{task} is a long road. Here it is in three short stages; walk only the first for now.
Too large for one cut. Three smaller ones, then: begin with the first and let the others wait.
A new chapter of my journey is open. Read it later, when the work is resting.
Another day of steady work, and the road reveals a new chapter. It will keep until you have time.
